title: fix(hooks): preserve exact linked discovery paths
body:
Related: #130813

## What Problem This Solves

Configured linked-hook roots containing literal whitespace can silently select a trimmed sibling and execute the wrong handler.

## User Impact

Discovery preserves the filesystem path the operator configured. A missing literal directory no longer loads its trimmed sibling. Ordinary roots retain their behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep the contributor's repair in the one private shared discovery owner. The global resolver, installer, containment/source policy, schema, SDK and defaults are unchanged. The existing non-normalizing string filter and home/invocation-base helpers preserve accepted directory bytes.

Maintainer simplification reuses the existing workspace filesystem suite with a literal configured root, retaining every original assertion and case. This catches the regression without adding test lines or maintaining a second fixture table; the now-unneeded test allocation is removed. Total PR test-line delta: **0**. Production remains **+18/-6**.

## Independent Maintainer Evidence

Built CLI and real Gateway, secretless Linux arm64 Docker, Node 24.22.1: two main runs and two candidate runs. Main executes all three trimmed decoys and the missing-root decoy, with zero literal-hook executions. Candidate executes each actual absolute/relative/home-prefixed literal hook once, no decoy, and rejects `hooks info missing-hook` with exit 1. The ordinary hook executes once in every run. Config roots and canonical SQLite install records remain unchanged; all Gateways join SIGTERM exit 0 without forced termination.

[Full independent capture, commands, controls, check results and limits](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187554#issuecomment-6494009126).

The existing workspace regression fixture fails its two positive-discovery cases on main and passes all six cases on candidate. Candidate focused checks have 36 passes and nine bundle-plugin loader failures; the exact same nine failures reproduce in that complete file on pinned main (22 pass/9 fail). Those bundle-manifest paths do not use the changed extraDirs branch. They are recorded, not fixed or reported as green. Targeted format/lint passed. Hosted CI is judged separately on the final head.

Merge danger: the code change is a two-way door, with no persisted-state migration; reverting cannot undo side effects of a hook already executed. Blast radius is hook discovery from configured extraDirs, shared by CLI inventory and Gateway loading. Wrong path identity can select the wrong local code, so ordinary, missing-root and trimmed-decoy controls are retained.

Related: #130813

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: hook discovery can load a different directory when a configured linked-hook path contains leading or trailing whitespace.

## User Impact

Configured paths now keep their filesystem identity. A valid literal directory loads correctly, and a missing literal directory cannot silently select its trimmed sibling.

## Why This Change Was Made

Preserve accepted nonblank directory strings in the one shared discovery owner. Resolve home/invocation bases through existing helpers without trimming the configured directory. This follows the existing linked-hook contract from #130813 and keeps the global resolver, installer, manifest containment and schema unchanged.

## Evidence

- Scenario: Configured hook extraDirs preserve literal filesystem whitespace during discovery and loading; A nonexistent literal root cannot load its trimmed sibling; Ordinary roots and released hook install/config state retain their contracts.
- Entry: Published openclaw plugins install --link and config set hooks.internal.load.extraDirs, then normal built openclaw.mjs hooks list/info and gateway run.; disputed owner ran unmocked: src/hooks/workspace.ts private resolveHookDiscoveryRoots extraDirs, shared by actual inventory/discovery/runtime loader; global path resolver, installer, schema, bundled/plugin roots and manifest containment unchanged.
- Same command on base `540091c` and head `82255ff`: `python3 hooks-latest-release-proof.py --base "$BASE_CHECKOUT" --head "$HEAD_CHECKOUT" --node-dir "$NODE_DIR" --release-prefix "$RELEASE_PREFIX" --release-version 2026.10.8 --label "$LABEL"`
  - Before (base): RED BASE executes DECOY_LITERAL1 and DECOY_MISSING1 instead of literal0; ordinarycontrol1. CLIinfo selects trimmed path although releasedconfig retains whitespace. Canonical installs andseedunchanged.
  - After (head): GREEN exacthead executes LITERAL1 and ORDINARY1, bothdecoys0; literalinfo and moduleURL preserve space/%20; canonicalinstallrecords equal published, BASE/HEAD configSHA equal, unchangedread-onlyseed; normalSIGTERMexit0/noforce/containerabsent bothrefs.
- Readback (subprocess,sqlite,disk): Actual CLI descriptor paths and disk handler append logs with import.meta.url; independent Node builtin SQLite reader reads config_machine_state hooks.internal.installs; config bytes and released seed hashes before/after, actual process exit/containerabsence and normal build-info/buildstamp.
- Proof harness: Frozen parameterized collector SHA256 212a8938e3423d490f19b06d0715817886fd49c1d9a4c57dbd342f0145927d6b; cached Ubuntu24 container actualbuilt CLI/Gateway, isolated HOME/state/workspace and network:none, readonly product/Node/release; no discovery/install/load/dispatch mock. Native hostlibc2.28 cannotload proc-safe requiring2.33, so qualifiedglibc2.39 image is explicitly used.
- Control: Same ordinaryhook runs1onbothrefs and validliteralruns1onhead; twoexistingdecoysrun1eachonBASEbut0onHEAD, missingliteralnotdiscovered. Config's three roots and canonical released install records retain exact whitespace. No mocked successful dispatch/record.
- Other callers checked: Complete sharedextraDirs discovery owner covers inventory/info/status/handlerloading/bootstrap; absolute/relative/homeprefix all in focused filesystemtable. No per-output split, sharedresolver policy, pluginAPI, config/schema/protocol or permission change.
- Tests: Four canonical files49/49PASS; final workspace file9/9PASS31.603s. Focusedtypes102.470s/lint134.264s, format,linecap/testallocation49 andnormalhooksPASS; normalclean cliStartup224.041s. POSIXwhitespacefilesystemcases explicitlyskipWindows. (measured cost: Fourfile command193.344s processwall includes118.914s preparation; finalsingleworkspace31.603s wall. Production+18/-6; test+50/-1(net49), uniqueallocation49, unchangedsharedscalar. No fullsuite/retry/timeout/assertionweakening.)
- Not tested: NativeWindows/macOS, productionservices, providers/channels/models, managedupdate/service orchestration, liveproviderworkloads, performance or fullGateway/ControlUIhealth. The readonly cliStartup output logs optionalControlUIselfbuild EROFS; hooks discovery/import/dispatch and gracefulexit do complete. No UI health inferred.


Product head `82255ff28128b2fa71d5419a2fe7888e6bc5d4b7`; RED base `540091c8bd8bfc537f5620221390057a801fd3a2`. Normal clean `cliStartup` build passes224.041s; both actual build stamps match their commits with `inputsClean:true`. Linux x64, Node26.12.1, isolated Ubuntu24/glibc2.39 container;2026-10-29 UTC. The native host's glibc2.28 cannot load current proc-safe, so the actual built runtime is exercised in the declared cached image, with network disabled and product/Node/release read-only. Docker17 needs the qualified seccomp compatibility flag; private state/workspace/HOME remain isolated.

**Latest-stable upgrade unit:** actual published OpenClaw2026.10.8(dc2523e), release2026-10-27, is normally installed in a private prefix. npm's initial five skipped lifecycles were explicitly approved with its supported local command and actually rebuilt; no pending scripts remain. One actual release-created install/config state is frozen and copied byte-for-byte for BASE and HEAD. Both run the existing supported credential-preparation Doctor, ordinary CLI list/info and real Gateway startup. This is one common published seed with two candidate upgrades, not manually fabricated product rows or two unrelated setups.

| Readback | BASE | Head |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Actual literal hook executed | 0 | 1 |
| Trimmed literal decoy executed | 1 | 0 |
| Trimmed missing-root decoy executed | 1 | 0 |
| Ordinary positive-control hook executed | 1 | 1 |
| Literal handler path | `linked-hook/handler.js` | `linked-hook /handler.js` |
| Canonical install records equal release | yes | yes |
| Config retains all three exact roots | yes | yes |
| Normal SIGTERM exit / forced kill / container left | 0 / no / no | 0 / no / no |

Handlers append actual `gateway:startup` records and their imported module URL to disk. The literal HEAD module contains `linked-hook%20/handler.js`; no loader/handler mock is involved. The ordinary marker is the valid positive control and follows configured handlers in registration order. The independent readonly SQLite reader uses `config_machine_state`, key `hooks.internal.installs`, and verifies exact sourcePath/installPath/installedAt equality with the published seed. Post-shutdown BASE/HEAD config hashes are identical; the read-only published seed hash stays unchanged. Actual counts, descriptors, commands, registry integrity and cleanup are below.

```sh
python3 hooks-latest-release-proof.py \
  --base "$BASE_CHECKOUT" --head "$HEAD_CHECKOUT" \
  --node-dir "$NODE_DIR" --release-prefix "$RELEASE_PREFIX" \
  --release-version 2026.10.8 --label "$LABEL"
```

Frozen complete collector SHA256`212a8938e3423d490f19b06d0715817886fd49c1d9a4c57dbd342f0145927d6b`;111.668s wall for the paired upgrade/actualruntime proof. Preparation of the missing exact release took one normal328.099s install, then0.567/1.520/0.918s lifecycle approve/rebuild/readback, entirely private to this task. The synthetic fixture token exists only inside the network-isolated proof and is not a real account credential. A trailing slash on the link command preserves the literal basename without testing the separate installer parsing issue.

Focused real-filesystem table covers absolute, invocation-relative and home-prefixed inputs, valid literal plus both decoys, missing literal, ordinaryroot and blank entries. Four canonical test files49/49PASS,193.344s processwall including118.914s preparation; finalworkspace9/9PASS31.603s. Focusedtypes102.470s, typedlint134.264s, format, linecap, exacttestlineallocation49 and normalhooks pass. Production+18/-6; test+50/-1(net49); sharedscalarunchanged. POSIX filenamecases skipWindows explicitly; no timeout/retry/assertion is weakened and no fullsuite is run. Independent source review and author simplification pass.

Not tested: native Windows/macOS, productionservices, providers/channels/models, performance, managedupdater/service orchestration or fullGateway/ControlUIhealth. The deliberately readonly cliStartup output reports an optional ControlUI self-build `EROFS` warning; actual hook discovery/import/startup dispatch and graceful shutdown complete. That warning is retained, and no UI or whole-Gateway health is claimed. No shared configuration or production service changed. Existing containment/hardlink and manifest behavior stay unchanged; no new schema/protocol/config/default/permission/upgrade decision. Hosted CI is pending.

<summary>Complete frozen parameterized collector</summary>

Use clean normally built BASE/head checkouts, supported Node and a normally installed exact published release. The named cached Ubuntu24 image needs glibc2.33+; the recorded imageID appears above. The collector writes only a new task artifact directory, isolated state/workspace and private loopback container; it cannot reach production channels. Supply a new label each execution.

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One published seed, equivalent state copies, real built BASE/HEAD hook dispatch."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--base', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--head', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--node-dir', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--release-prefix', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--release-version', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--label', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--image', default='alix-openclaw-webkit:pw1.64.1-ubuntu24')
args = parser.parse_args()
assert args.label.replace('-', '').isalnum()
task = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
output = task / ('hooks-latest-proof-' + args.label)
output.mkdir()
published = output / 'published'
node_dir = args.node_dir.resolve()
node = node_dir / 'bin/node'
release_prefix = args.release_prefix.resolve()
package = release_prefix / 'node_modules/openclaw'
base = args.base.resolve()
head = args.head.resolve()
assert json.loads((package / 'package.json').read_text())['version'] == args.release_version
release_lock = json.loads((release_prefix / 'package-lock.json').read_text())['packages']['node_modules/openclaw']
assert release_lock['version'] == args.release_version
receipt = {
    'startedAt': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()),
    'collectorSha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'release': {'version': args.release_version, 'registryArchive': release_lock['resolved'], 'integrity': release_lock['integrity']},
    'image': args.image,
    'imageId': subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'image', 'inspect', args.image, '--format', '{{.Id}}'], text=True).strip(),
    'releaseCommands': [], 'phases': {},
}
for directory in (published / 'state', published / 'home', output / 'workspace', output / 'empty-bundled'):
    directory.mkdir(parents=True)


def tree_hash(directory):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for item in sorted(directory.rglob('*')):
        if item.is_file():
            digest.update(str(item.relative_to(directory)).encode())
            digest.update(b'\0')
            digest.update(item.read_bytes())
    return digest.hexdigest()


def install_records(database):
    script = '''import {DatabaseSync} from "node:sqlite";
const db = new DatabaseSync(process.argv[2], {readOnly: true});
const row = db.prepare("SELECT value_json FROM config_machine_state WHERE state_key = ?").get("hooks.internal.installs");
if (!row) throw new Error("No canonical hook install row");
console.log(row.value_json);
db.close();
'''
    result = subprocess.run([str(node), '--input-type=module', '-', str(database)], input=script,
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    return json.loads(result.stdout)


def write_hook(directory, name, value):
    directory.mkdir()
    (directory / 'HOOK.md').write_text('---\nname: ' + name + '\ndescription: "' + value + '"\n'
        'metadata: {"openclaw":{"events":["gateway:startup"]}}\n---\n')
    (directory / 'handler.js').write_text('import {appendFileSync} from "node:fs";\n'
        'export default async function(event) {\n'
        '  appendFileSync(process.env.OPENCLAW_HOOK_PROOF_LOG, JSON.stringify({marker: '
        + json.dumps(value) + ', type: event.type, action: event.action, module: import.meta.url}) + "\\n");\n}\n')


def container(checkout, phase=None, name=None):
    selected_state = published / 'state' if phase is None else phase / 'state'
    selected_home = published / 'home' if phase is None else phase / 'home'
    cmd = ['docker', 'run', '--rm', '--network', 'none', '--security-opt', 'seccomp=unconfined',
           '--user', str(os.getuid()) + ':' + str(os.getgid()), '--workdir', str(output)]
    if name:
        cmd += ['--name', name]
    for directory in dict.fromkeys([node_dir, release_prefix, base, head]):
        cmd += ['--volume', str(directory) + ':' + str(directory) + ':ro']
    cmd += ['--volume', str(output) + ':' + str(output)]
    if phase is not None:
        cmd += ['--volume', str(published) + ':' + str(published) + ':ro',
                '--volume', str(phase / 'workspace') + ':' + str(output / 'workspace')]
    environment = {
        'HOME': str(selected_home), 'OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR': str(selected_state),
        'OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH': str(selected_state / 'openclaw.json'),
        'OPENCLAW_BUNDLED_HOOKS_DIR': str(output / 'empty-bundled'),
        'OPENCLAW_HOOK_PROOF_LOG': str((phase or output) / 'dispatch.jsonl'),
        'NO_COLOR': '1', 'PATH': str(node_dir / 'bin') + ':/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin',
    }
    for key, value in environment.items():
        cmd += ['--env', key + '=' + value]
    return cmd + [args.image, str(node), str(checkout / 'openclaw.mjs')]


def command(stage, checkout, cli_args, phase=None):
    destination = phase or output
    argv = container(checkout, phase) + cli_args
    started = time.monotonic()
    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    (destination / (stage + '.stdout')).write_text(result.stdout)
    (destination / (stage + '.stderr')).write_text(result.stderr)
    record = {'stage': stage, 'argv': argv, 'cliArgs': cli_args, 'code': result.returncode,
              'elapsedSeconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)}
    (receipt['releaseCommands'] if phase is None else receipt['phases'][phase.name]['commands']).append(record)
    assert result.returncode == 0, stage + ': ' + result.stderr[-2500:] + result.stdout[-2500:]
    return result.stdout


def run_phase(phase_name, checkout, expected):
    phase = output / phase_name
    phase.mkdir()
    for source, dest in [(published / 'state', phase / 'state'), (published / 'home', phase / 'home'),
                         (output / 'workspace', phase / 'workspace')]:
        shutil.copytree(source, dest)
    state_hash = tree_hash(phase / 'state')
    assert state_hash == tree_hash(published / 'state'), 'Candidate seed copy changed bytes'
    product_head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=checkout, text=True).strip()
    build = json.loads((checkout / 'dist/build-info.json').read_text())
    stamp = json.loads((checkout / 'dist/.buildstamp').read_text())
    assert build['commit'] == stamp['head'] == product_head and stamp['inputsClean'] is True
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=checkout, text=True) == ''
    data = {'head': product_head, 'buildInfo': build, 'buildStamp': stamp, 'commands': [],
            'seedStateSha256': state_hash, 'expected': expected}
    receipt['phases'][phase_name] = data
    migration = json.loads(command('credential-migration', checkout,
        ['doctor', '--client-credentials', '--repair', '--non-interactive', '--json'], phase))
    assert migration['ok'] is True
    data['migration'] = migration
    listed = json.loads(command('list', checkout, ['hooks', 'list', '--json'], phase))
    literal_info = json.loads(command('info-literal', checkout, ['hooks', 'info', 'literal-hook', '--json'], phase))
    ordinary_info = json.loads(command('info-ordinary', checkout, ['hooks', 'info', 'ordinary-hook', '--json'], phase))
    data['listed'] = [{'name': x['name'], 'description': x['description']} for x in listed['hooks']]
    data['literalInfo'] = literal_info
    data['ordinaryInfo'] = ordinary_info
    assert ordinary_info['baseDir'] == str(output / 'ordinary-hook')
    assert json.loads((phase / 'state/openclaw.json').read_text())['hooks']['internal']['load']['extraDirs'] == roots
    data['configExtraDirs'] = roots
    name = 'alix-hooks-latest-' + args.label + '-' + phase_name + '-' + str(os.getpid())
    gateway_args = ['gateway', 'run', '--bind', 'loopback', '--auth', 'token',
                    '--token', 'private-hook-proof-token', '--port', '19479']
    argv = container(checkout, phase, name) + gateway_args
    gateway_out = (phase / 'gateway.stdout').open('w')
    gateway_err = (phase / 'gateway.stderr').open('w')
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=gateway_out, stderr=gateway_err)
    dispatch = []
    cleanup = {}
    try:
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 45
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            marker = phase / 'dispatch.jsonl'
            if marker.exists():
                dispatch = [json.loads(line) for line in marker.read_text().splitlines()]
                if any(row['marker'] == 'ORDINARY' for row in dispatch):
                    break
            assert child.poll() is None, 'Gateway exited before the ordinary-path startup control'
            time.sleep(0.1)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('Gateway did not dispatch the ordinary startup control')
    finally:
        if child.poll() is None:
            stopped = subprocess.run(['docker', 'kill', '--signal', 'SIGTERM', name], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
            cleanup['signalCommandCode'] = stopped.returncode
        try:
            cleanup['processCode'] = child.wait(timeout=25)
            cleanup['forced'] = False
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            subprocess.run(['docker', 'kill', '--signal', 'SIGKILL', name], capture_output=True, timeout=10)
            cleanup['processCode'] = child.wait(timeout=10)
            cleanup['forced'] = True
        gateway_out.close()
        gateway_err.close()
        cleanup['containerAbsent'] = subprocess.run(['docker', 'container', 'inspect', name], capture_output=True).returncode != 0
        data['cleanup'] = cleanup
    data['gatewayCommand'] = gateway_args
    data['dispatch'] = dispatch
    counts = Counter(row['marker'] for row in dispatch)
    data['dispatchCounts'] = {key: counts[key] for key in ['LITERAL', 'DECOY_LITERAL', 'DECOY_MISSING', 'ORDINARY']}
    assert cleanup == {'signalCommandCode': 0, 'processCode': 0, 'forced': False, 'containerAbsent': True}
    assert all(row['type'] == 'gateway' and row['action'] == 'startup' for row in dispatch)
    expected_markers = ['LITERAL', 'ORDINARY'] if expected == 'GREEN' else ['DECOY_LITERAL', 'DECOY_MISSING', 'ORDINARY']
    assert sorted(row['marker'] for row in dispatch) == expected_markers
    descriptions = {entry['name']: entry['description'] for entry in listed['hooks']}
    assert descriptions == ({'literal-hook': 'LITERAL', 'ordinary-hook': 'ORDINARY'} if expected == 'GREEN' else
                            {'literal-hook': 'DECOY_LITERAL', 'missing-hook': 'DECOY_MISSING', 'ordinary-hook': 'ORDINARY'})
    assert literal_info['baseDir'] == str(output / ('linked-hook ' if expected == 'GREEN' else 'linked-hook'))
    data['canonicalInstallRecordsAfter'] = install_records(phase / 'state/state/openclaw.sqlite')
    assert data['canonicalInstallRecordsAfter'] == receipt['publishedInstallRecords']
    assert tree_hash(published) == receipt['publishedSeedSha256'], 'Published seed changed'
    data['publishedSeedUnchanged'] = True
    data['observed'] = expected
    data['result'] = 'PASS'
    print(json.dumps({'phase': phase_name, 'head': product_head, 'observed': expected, 'dispatchCounts': data['dispatchCounts']}), flush=True)


try:
    literal = output / 'linked-hook '
    ordinary = output / 'ordinary-hook'
    missing = output / 'missing-hook  '
    write_hook(literal, 'literal-hook', 'LITERAL')
    write_hook(output / 'linked-hook', 'literal-hook', 'DECOY_LITERAL')
    write_hook(ordinary, 'ordinary-hook', 'ORDINARY')
    write_hook(output / 'missing-hook', 'missing-hook', 'DECOY_MISSING')
    assert literal.is_dir() and not missing.exists()
    initial = {'plugins': {'enabled': False}, 'agents': {'defaults': {'workspace': str(output / 'workspace')}},
               'gateway': {'mode': 'local', 'port': 19479, 'auth': {'mode': 'token', 'token': 'private-hook-proof-token'}},
               'hooks': {'internal': {'enabled': True}}}
    (published / 'state/openclaw.json').write_text(json.dumps(initial))
    receipt['releaseVersion'] = command('release-version', package, ['--version']).strip()
    assert '2026.10.8' in receipt['releaseVersion'] if args.release_version == '2026.10.8' else args.release_version in receipt['releaseVersion']
    for stage, root in [('release-link-literal', literal), ('release-link-ordinary', ordinary)]:
        command(stage, package, ['plugins', 'install', str(root) + '/', '--force', '--link', '--accept-capabilities'])
    roots = [str(literal), str(missing), str(ordinary)]
    command('release-select-roots', package, ['config', 'set', 'hooks.internal.load.extraDirs', json.dumps(roots), '--strict-json'])
    assert json.loads((published / 'state/openclaw.json').read_text())['hooks']['internal']['load']['extraDirs'] == roots
    receipt['publishedExtraDirs'] = roots
    receipt['publishedInstallRecords'] = install_records(published / 'state/state/openclaw.sqlite')
    assert receipt['publishedInstallRecords']['literal-hook']['installPath'] == str(literal)
    assert receipt['publishedInstallRecords']['ordinary-hook']['installPath'] == str(ordinary)
    receipt['publishedSeedSha256'] = tree_hash(published)
    run_phase('base', base, 'RED')
    run_phase('head', head, 'GREEN')
    assert receipt['phases']['base']['seedStateSha256'] == receipt['phases']['head']['seedStateSha256']
    receipt['equivalentSeedCopies'] = True
    receipt['result'] = 'PASS'
except BaseException as error:
    receipt['result'] = 'BLOCKED'
    receipt['error'] = repr(error)
    raise
finally:
    receipt['finishedAt'] = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())
    (output / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'output': str(output), 'result': receipt['result'], 'error': receipt.get('error')}), flush=True)
```
